entries.title: Among the Sleep
entries.definitive_edition: Among the Sleep - Enhanced Edition on Windows PC

emulation.notes: Use the Enhanced Edition on PC; no console emulation route is needed.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Enhanced Unity PC presentation with PC settings and capture flexibility.

primary.why: The Windows PC Enhanced Edition is the best route because it adds improved visuals, integrated artbook and soundtrack, selectable pyjamas, enhanced puzzles and gameplay, new dialogue, and a museum level while keeping PC capture/settings flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Buy Among the Sleep - Enhanced Edition on Steam and play the Windows PC build. The Prologue DLC is free on Steam if you want the extra prelude after the main run.
